newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Kok says Albania operation would need UN mandate.
newsitem.headline: Kok says Albania operation would need UN mandate.

text.p: Dutch Prime Minister Wim Kok said on Friday that any international intervention in Albania would need an explicit United Nations mandate.

Speaking at a weekly briefing to journalists, Kok, whose country currently holds the EU presidency, said: "There will no decision on an international presence without a clear mandate and the Security Coucil has not yet issued a mandate for international action."
He said that any involvement would need a clear understanding of the situation in Albania. "To my understanding it's not a civil war, there is no other description than anarchy," he said.
The EU said it was working closely with the Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe and NATO on a coordinated response.
